neighbours.label: word opening a predicate that classifies the subject (become a, remain a, be the, like)
fire: Over the years, the town has become a magnet for young artists.
Despite his fame, he remains a quiet and modest man.
Many experts consider her to be the best player of her generation.
After the war, the old factory turned into a museum.
In those days, workers lived like slaves to the mine owners.
With practice, anyone can become a confident public speaker.
Malgré les critiques, elle reste une excellente actrice.
Scientists believe these birds may be the last of their kind.
quiet: Over the years, the town has hired a team of young artists.
Despite his fame, he drives a quiet and modest car.
Many experts asked her to coach the best player of her generation.
After the war, the old factory hired a museum guide.
In those days, workers carried coal to the mine owners.
With practice, anyone can give a confident public speech.
Malgré les critiques, elle achète une excellente voiture.
Scientists believe these birds may eat the last of the seeds.

predictions: Fires on the article or 'like' after become/remain/be/consider that starts a description of what the subject is; quiet on the same article after an action verb taking an object.
notes: Card: ' a' x10, ' the' x8, un, like ('become a society', 'lived like serfs', 'reste un grand fan'). Probes: become a 0.427, appear to be the 0.377, reste un 0.417, lived like 0.407; 'bought a' 0.009, 'built a' 0.019; 'Humans are a' stayed under 0.18.
